read_bytes_from_petrel: create a function that reads bytes from a petrel:// path using PetrelBackend.get()
write_bytes_to_petrel: create a function that writes bytes to a petrel:// path using PetrelBackend.put()
list_files_in_petrel_dir: build a python module that lists files and directories in a petrel:// path using PetrelBackend.list_dir_or_file()
copy_file_in_petrel: create a function that copies a file from one petrel:// path to another using PetrelBackend.copyfile()
download_petrel_file_locally: build a python module that downloads a petrel:// file to a local temp path using PetrelBackend.get_local_path()
